findings.title: Backfill loop can run forever when the batch selects rows whose value is already equal
findings.evidence: The loop exits only when ROW_COUNT is zero, but the subquery keeps selecting rows where shipping_region is NULL and legacy_region is NOT NULL. If legacy_region is also NULL-equivalent for assignment or the selected rows are repeatedly matched without changing state, the loop never makes progress and the migration hangs inside BEGIN/COMMIT.
findings.recommendation: Make progress explicit in the UPDATE predicate so already-processed rows cannot be reselected, for example by updating from a CTE and filtering rows that will actually change state, or by selecting FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED and adding a stronger termination condition tied to the selected batch rather than ROW_COUNT alone. At minimum, include a guard proving the updated rows leave the selection set after each iteration.
